title: FluentAssertions
description: A library for writing expressive, readable assertions in your tests.

data.text: `FluentAssertions` replaces traditional `Assert` calls with a fluent, English-like syntax. It produces much more readable test failures and supports deep object comparison, collection assertions, and string matching.
FluentAssertions uses method chaining to express expectations. The failure messages are human-readable and include both expected and actual values.

data.title: FluentAssertions Basics

data.text: FluentAssertions provides powerful collection assertions that make verifying lists and dictionaries easy.

data.title: Collection Assertions

terms.definition: The entry point for all FluentAssertions assertions.
An assertion that the subject equals the expected value.
An assertion that a collection contains a specific item or matches a predicate.

data.title: Tip
data.text: FluentAssertions failure messages include the full object graph, making debugging failing tests much faster.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: FluentAssertions uses Should() for a fluent assertion API
Readable failure messages speed up debugging
Supports collections, strings, dates, and exceptions
Works with xUnit, NUnit, and MSTest
data.takeaway: FluentAssertions makes tests read like specifications and failures easy to diagnose.
